messages:
pagerduty-bot: [PagerDuty] ALERT fired: REDWOOD-PROD - inference-api high 5xx rate (service: inference-proxy) incident INC-2026-4821. Priority: P1. Trigger: error-rate > 3% over 2m. Affected region: us-west-2. Links: https://pagerduty.example/INC-2026-4821

Ava (oncall): acking, jumping in now. seeing spike in 5xx from the edge loadbalancer.

Ava (oncall): quick check: `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep proxy` shows 3/5 proxy pods in CrashLoopBackOff 😬

Marcus: pinging in, on secondary. can you paste the crash logs?

Ava (oncall): grabbing logs, pasting tail:
```
2026-03-14T07:10:12Z inference-proxy[main] ERROR: upstream connection reset by peer
2026-03-14T07:10:13Z inference-proxy[main] ERROR: failed to stream tokens: kv-cache miss after migrate
2026-03-14T07:10:14Z inference-proxy[main] FATAL: GPU pool exhausted: request queue full
```

incident-bot: Note: Auto-escalation timer started (5m) for INC-2026-4821. If primary does not acknowledge further pages, secondary will be paged.

Ava (oncall): I can repro locally on a single proxy node — looks like a memory leak in the new routing patch that landed in the last deploy. rolling restart of proxy pods may help as mitigation.

Priya: Heads up — we have a customer-facing job that runs every minute for two large customers, could be impacted. marking as potential customer impact.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation: primary did not acknowledge within 5m. Secondary Marcus paged.

Marcus: acking now. I'm going to remove the recently deployed routing feature from the deployment config and restart the proxy pool. Doing a quick canary rollback: `kubectl -n inference set image deployment/proxy proxy=image:stable-2026-03-12`

Marcus: rolling restart initiated. running `kubectl rollout status deployment/proxy -n inference`

Marcus: rollout stuck on pod 2/5, failing postStart hook. digging into pod logs for that pod.

incident-bot: PD: INC-2026-4821 escalated to manager oncall (Eli) due to secondary unack after 8m.

Eli (manager): I'm awake, on my way. thanks for the heads up. if rollback doesn't work, consider routing traffic to fallback model (smaller model) to reduce GPU memory pressure.

Marcus: I can confirm postStart hook failing is due to a shared mount not being available after the deploy. mounting error: `failed to mount /var/cache/inference: no such file or directory` — looks like an init script race after the deploy.

Ava (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) scale up GPU pool by +2 nodes to buy time; 2) route 50% traffic to fallback-model-v1; 3) restart proxy pods after ensuring /var/cache exists on nodes.

Priya: I can update routing config in control plane to send 50% to fallback. prepping patch now.

Marcus: scaling GPU pool via autoscaler API: `curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/scale -d '{"pool":"gpu-prod","delta":2}'` — submitted, nodes provisioning.

Priya: routing change applied. verification: synthetic traffic shows avg latency dropping and 5xx rate halved.

Ava (oncall): created the missing dir on nodes via daemonset patch, restarting proxy pods again. `kubectl delete pod -l app=proxy -n inference`

Marcus: pods coming up healthy. 5/5 proxies ready. 5xx back to baseline ~0.2% ✅

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-4821 acknowledged by Marcus and resolved from alert state to monitoring (auto-close in 30m) — update your runbook notes.

Sana: filing follow-up: we need a postmortem and a runbook update: add pre-deploy check for init mounts, and add a knob to quickly route traffic to fallback models. I'll own the postmortem.

Eli (manager): thanks team. please capture customer impact: which tenants were affected and duration.

Priya: quick estimate: two large tenants saw 30-40% error rate from 07:10:00 to 07:22:00 UTC. I'm capturing logs and billing windows.

Ava (oncall): adding runbook note: mitigation steps we used: 1) scale GPU pool, 2) route to fallback-model, 3) ensure missing mount created, 4) restart proxies. Also adding the commands we ran.

Ava (oncall): follow-up tasks: `- patch deployment to remove faulty routing feature (PR #582)
- add pre-deploy check for /var/cache
- add alerting for GPU pool saturation at 80%`

Sana: assigning follow-ups: PR #582 revert (Marcus), runbook update (Ava), postmortem (Sana).

Eli (manager): good work. one action: add PagerDuty escalation timeout doc note — we should customize the primary timeout for inference-prod to 3m instead of 5m when priority=P1.

Marcus: noted. I'll open a ticket to adjust PD policy and add rationale.

Priya: I'll notify account managers for the two affected tenants and add a brief customer note.

Sana: closing note: we'll schedule a retro and include improved testing for init scripts.

Ava (oncall): thanks everyone — dropping off now; ping me on thread if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:

Eli (manager): closing the loop — mark INCIDENT: postmortem in progress. :white_check_mark:
